exposure: retained products of conception (RPOC) after delivery
retained products of conception (RPOC) after abortion
cohort: Participants were women who underwent operative hysteroscopies for suspected retained products of conception between 2011 and 2015, where trophoblastic tissue was obtained.
finding: Pregnancies following hysteroscopic removal of retained products of conception after delivery entail a higher rate of abnormal placentation compared to those after abortion.
mod_finding: A significant rate of vaginal deliveries in both post-delivery and post-abortion groups required manual removal of the placenta or exploration of the uterine cavity.
